title: Fire Emblem Beat Total War at The Game Awards
hook:
Fire Emblem: Three Houses beat Total War: Three Kingdoms for Best Strategy Game at The Game Awards 2019, and this week Fortune's Weave was nominated for Best RPG after selling 1.3 million copies in about two weeks. Can Fire Emblem bring home another trophy?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Fire Emblem beat Total War at The Game Awards? Fire Emblem had been around since nineteen ninety, but Three Houses gave the series a night to remember in December twenty nineteen. That night at The Game Awards, Three Houses won Best Strategy Game. It beat Total War: Three Kingdoms, Anno Eighteen Hundred, Age of Wonders: Planetfall, Tropico Six and Wargroove. It also won the fan voted Player's Voice award that same night. Sales matched the hype. Nintendo reported more than two point eight million copies sold by March twenty twenty, less than a year after launch. Now the franchise is back on the ballot. Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave launched on Switch Two on September seventeenth. Nintendo's latest earnings report put it past one point three million copies after only about two weeks on sale. This week, on November seventeenth, The Game Awards announced its nominees, and Fortune's Weave is up for Best Role Playing Game. It is facing Final Fantasy Resonance and Trails in the Sky Second Chapter, among others. Winners get announced on December tenth. Three Houses needed a strategy category to win. Fortune's Weave is fighting the big RPGs head on. Can Fire Emblem bring home another trophy? Follow for more gaming history.
